falsePositiveControls.label: Control 1: topical similarity (same subject, fully independent wording)
falsePositiveControls.expectation: near-zero — same TOPIC as REFERENCE_TEXT but no shared 5-word shingles/live confirmation, since the matcher is textual, not semantic

falsePositiveControls.label: Control 2: generic academic boilerplate only, no distinctive content
falsePositiveControls.expectation: near-zero — common phrasing alone must not accumulate into a meaningful match

falsePositiveControls.label: Control 3: genuine paraphrase of a real prior document (own-style rewrite, not a copy)
falsePositiveControls.note: prior-submission-corpus matching against REFERENCE_TEXT is intentionally not exercised here (requires the DB-backed matcher) — this control isolates the archive+live layers only, both of which are textual/shingle-based, not semantic
falsePositiveControls.expectation: near-zero on archive/live — paraphrasing in the author's own words/structure is acceptable per product philosophy and should not trigger textual-reuse evidence
